evidence_role: frozen, exposed LOCAL-v1 regression; not blind and not official Windows execution
input: evaluation/cases_v1.json; all and only mode=3 rows

arms.on: Unmodified B3 from 最佳方法/代码/solver.py, including adaptive certified 2-, 3-, and 4-10-disc service planning.
arms.off: Same B3 with only TwoDiskSpatial/ThreeDiskSpatial/MultiDiskSpatial service dispatch bypassed to TrialSpatial._a1_service_round; retained behavior includes further bearings, inherited one-point trial clear, and original certified 25 m lattice cover_polygon fallback.

held_equal: physical source world and error field

analysis.pairing: exact case_id; ON minus OFF deltas
analysis.uncertainty: 20,000-repeat paired percentile bootstrap resampling 100 seed clusters; each selected cluster includes all 12 scenes
analysis.regressions: retain every positive ON-minus-OFF seconds/source row

interpretation_gates.valid_comparison: all 2400 fresh runs fully clear and exit normally
interpretation_gates.stable_time_benefit: mean ON-minus-OFF seconds/source < 0 and seed-cluster bootstrap 95% CI upper < 0
interpretation_gates.headline_target: relative improvement around or above 0.5%; smaller stable effects reported exactly and not rounded up
interpretation_gates.no_time_claim: CI crosses zero or completeness differs; retain mechanism/diagnostic evidence only

observer_boundary: Runner passes only InterfaceOnly(env) to the strategy. Truth constructs LocalEnv before solver creation. env.stats() and returned counters are read only after run() exits; they never feed a decision.
truth_boundary: Source coordinates/count and environment stats are used by runner only to instantiate the registered world and audit after exit; strategy receives no case object, source list, or LocalEnv reference.
